edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key into the balances mapping for reads and writes.
msg.sender is used as the first key of the allowed mapping in approve and approveAndCall.
msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor.
The to parameter flows into the balances credit inside transfer.
The tokens parameter flows into the subtraction and addition inside transfer.
The spender parameter is written into allowed in approve.
The tokens parameter becomes the approved allowance in approve.
The from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter drives the balance and allowance subtractions in transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.

The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target in approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter becomes the allowance and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the spender contract callback.
The tokenAddress parameter is the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded as the amount of the external ERC20 transfer.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the pending owner assignment.
The _newOwner parameter is stored in the newOwner state variable.
newOwner is read and promoted to owner in acceptOwnership.
The owner address is passed as the recipient of transferAnyERC20Token.
The named return local balance carries the result of balanceOf.
The named return local remaining carries the result of allowance.
transfer performs SafeMath.sub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer performs SafeMath.add on balances[to].
transferFrom performs SafeMath.sub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom performs SafeMath.add on balances[to].
totalSupply performs SafeMath.sub of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
